meta.name: paper-search-usage
meta.description: This skill should be used when user asks to "search for papers", "find research papers", "search arXiv", "search PubMed", "find academic papers", "search IEEE", "search Scopus", or "look up scientific literature".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索并查找学术论文与科学文献
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速查找学术论文或科学文献
copy.tagline_en: Search and find academic papers and scientific literature
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly find academic papers or scientific literature

howto.what: 装好后,当你请求查找学术论文时,Claude 会调用多平台论文搜索工具,按关键词、作者或主题检索,覆盖 arXiv、PubMed、IEEE 等平台,并返回相关结果。
howto.when: 当你说“搜索论文”、“查找研究论文”、“搜索 arXiv”等话术时触发。

say.text: 帮我搜一下关于图神经网络的 arXiv 论文
say.note: 会调用 arXiv 检索相关预印本。

say.text: 在 PubMed 上查找关于阿尔茨海默病的最新研究
搜索 IEEE 上关于边缘计算的论文

howto.what_en: Once installed, when you ask to find academic papers, Claude uses built-in tools to search multiple platforms (e.g., arXiv, PubMed) by keyword, author, or topic and returns relevant results.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say things like 'search for papers', 'find research papers', or 'search arXiv'.

say_en.text: Find arXiv papers about graph neural networks.
Look up recent Alzheimer's disease research on PubMed.
Search IEEE for papers on edge computing.
